spellbook.finance/limitations: Delegated writes require the workspace owner role, and membership remains backend-enforced.
A deleted alert cannot be restored through this tool. Create it again with spellbook_alert_create.
Deleting an alert changes no inventory, listing or price.

description: Delete one saved alert by exact alertId, taken from spellbook_alerts_list, and return success. The alert stops watching at once. Read the list first and confirm with the person which alert to remove, because this tool cannot restore it.

alertId.description: The alertId of the alert to delete, from spellbook_alerts_list. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the alert belongs to, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_alert_delete
